name: Academic Ascent
note: 2-mana +2/+2 flying trick that also builds Jace, underwhelming as just a pump spell.

name: Blossom-Blessed Angel // Seed Suture
note: Ludicrous rate (2/4 flying vigilance) for a common, plus a strong Seed Suture back half.

name: Campus Crier
note: 2-mana 3/1 that can later exile from the graveyard to add loyalty to Jace.

name: Danitha, Sword of Hope
note: 2/2 first strike drawing a card once per turn off equipment or own-creature spells; better once it gets a counter.

name: Fateshaper Aspirant
note: Grade slides with how many legendary targets you have to return from the graveyard.

name: Generous Revival
note: Returns a cheap creature with a +1/+1 counter and has flashback; needs enough good 3-drops to be worth it.

name: Ghalta the Immovable
note: Needs a 4-5 toughness creature on board to become an affordable 7/7; risky if that creature gets removed.

name: Graft Surgeon
note: 3-mana 3/3 that redistributes its counters to another creature when it dies.

name: Hexhaven Battalion
note: Basic-land-cyclable sorcery that makes three 2/2s and a Jace; a board state in a box.

name: Koth of the Homestead
note: Landfall lifegain plus a +1/+1 counter per Plains, snowballs easily without costing anything.

name: Memory Trap
note: Reprint of the exile-until-leaves-play enchantment effect, a reliable format all-star.

name: Predictive Preparations
note: Needs counter synergies to shine; otherwise just a modest double-pump spell with flashback.

name: Prophesied End
note: Great if it only ever kills attackers, but forced non-attacker kills let the opponent draw a card.

name: Refute Destiny
note: Green/blue-hosing exile effect - dead in best-of-one, but strong to bring in against those colors.

name: Rescue Girl, First Responder
note: 1/3 flyer that bounces your own permanents for ETB value and can even rebounce a land for extra mana.

name: Saheeli, Consul of Oversight
note: Turns any scry or surveil, including a Jace's minus ability, into a free flying Thopter token.

name: Shatterwing Pegasus
note: Fits a flyers or go-wide deck but power level isn't quite high enough to overcome the synergy dependence.

name: Surgical Precision
note: Modal kill-a-big-creature or cantrip common with no real downside.

name: Teyo, Lightshield Expert
note: 2-mana 1/1 flash that grants hexproof plus a permanent counter, protecting a creature while adding stats.

name: Thalia, the Survivor
note: Great body (3/4 lifelink) that taxes opponents' noncreature spells and benefits from +1/+1 counters.

name: Tomik, Orzhov Lawmage
note: 2-mana 2/1 flyer with niche upside protecting Jace and enabling +1/+1 counter synergies.

name: Unflinching Hortimancer
note: 2-mana 2/1 Ward 1 that grows with lifegain, a nice payoff for the lifegain sub-theme.

name: Way of the Healer
note: Almost always nets a 2/2 token, a 3-loyalty Jace, and a Surveil for 4 mana.

name: Way of the Mentor
note: Needs a life-gain shell to turn loyalty gains into real value; weak as your first big play of the game.

name: Yoshimaru, Beloved Companion
note: Explosive counter-doubling engine that pairs well with other 3-mana legends like Koth and Danitha.

name: Your Fate Ends Here
note: A really solid removal spell; the mana-value-3-or-greater restriction favors killing the bigger threat anyway.

name: Yuriko, Blade of the Mighty
note: High-variance card: huge upside if it survives and attacks, but a 4-mana 2/3 is a blowout when answered.

name: Arni, Humble Scribe
note: Free looter that untaps whenever you play a nontoken creature, though it dies easily at 2 toughness.

name: Countersculpt
note: Essentially Cancel with a Surveil or bonus loyalty upside via Behold a Jace.

name: Cryotheory Adept
note: 2/1 prowess is mediocre as a beatdown plan, though the graveyard tap ability adds some value.

name: Divining Duelist
note: Flexible flash creature that taps/untaps a creature or loots, a fine if unexciting playable.

name: Fblthp, Impossibly Lost
note: Cool alternate win condition (graded build-around A+), but as a functional card it needs you to already be hitting your opponent.

name: Geist of Saint Thalia
note: At 2 mana the noncreature-spell cost discount is strong enough to build a deck around.

name: Hapatra, the Desert Frost
note: 4-mana 4/3 that taps and stuns an opponent's creature on entry, plus a repeatable untap ability.

name: Icy Reception
note: Twist on Essence Scatter that also hits legendary spells or shrinks a creature, useful to trigger prowess.

name: Infinite Coursework
note: Solid blue removal that taps a creature and strips its abilities so it can't untap.

name: Mindseeker Oculus
note: 3-mana 2/1 that draws a card and leaves behind an Empower Jace 4 token, huge value for a common.

name: Perfected Theory
note: Flexible power/toughness-setting instant, but this style of effect tends not to play out well.

name: Plan for All Outcomes
note: Sorcery-speed tuck effect on a permanent that keeps generating Empower Jace value off your first noncreature spell each turn.

name: Precise Redaction
note: Narrow counterspell that only hits white or black spells, best kept in the sideboard.

name: Proft, Consulting Detective
note: Strong scry/surveil payoff for counters and cards, but value depends on how much scry/surveil support you have.

name: Protege's Awakening
note: 4-mana draw 2 that can become a draw 3 if the leftover Jace token survives to be used.

name: Ruric Thar, Biomagus
note: 6-mana 4/6 flying double-prowess finisher that draws a card when targeted, but still a costly card to lose.

name: Semester Foreseer // Peer Review
note: Rock-solid playable: 4-mana 3/4 that surveils on entry, plus the Peer Review flashback half.

name: Sphinx's Approach
note: Card-disadvantage draw-2 whose bonus mode needs 4 copies plus a Sphinx in play, too slow and cute for limited.

name: Surveillance Phantasm
note: Efficient 2-mana 2/3 flying defender that can attack and gives you a way to surveil if needed.

name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
note: Makes small creatures unblockable and has historically overperformed in aggro decks full of 1-toughness bodies.

name: Traxos, Academy Guardian
note: 1/5 flying vigilance with prowess that can cost as little as 2 mana after casting a noncreature spell.

name: Undulating Witness
note: Big 3/5 flyer for 5 mana with a small pump ability, comparable to the set's basic landcyclers.

name: Unsummon
note: Cheap, efficient bounce that's especially good against tokens and can save your own creature.

name: Way of the Cryomancer
note: Empowers Jace and lets a loyalty ability copy your next spell, but Jace's built-in -3 already does more.

name: Way of the Mind Sculptor
note: Draws 2 cards and leaves a 2-loyalty Jace, best in decks that keep triggering loyalty abilities that remove 2+ counters.

name: Yargle, Goliath of Otaria
note: Luis: matchup-dependent, great vs. red-green but a C/C- overall and a sideboard card; Marshall floated D or F for the maindeck without settling.

name: Yuriko, Hope from the Shadows
note: 1-mana flash 1/1 with a flexible ETB (shrink an attacker or Surveil 2), close to a full card's worth of value.

name: Apex Witchstalker
note: A big menace body that can gain 4 life across its lifecycle, fills black's aggressive-green-creature slot.

name: Break Under Pressure
note: Forces the sacrifice of an opponent's best permanent and gains 2 life, a great and reliable effect.

name: Cast Away Doubt
note: Good for aggressive red-black, black-green, and black-white decks; worse in blue-black which doesn't want to pay life to draw.

name: Danitha, Spear of Agony
note: Cheap first striker that only needs one targeted spell to become a 3/3, and black has plenty of removal to trigger it.

name: Extended Absence
note: Premium exile removal that also pings for 1 and gains a life, strong in every deck.

name: Gallia, Tragic Host
note: 2-mana 2/1 menace that can recur itself from the graveyard for 5 mana plus a counter, hard to keep down.

name: Last Gasp
note: Efficient reprint removal, -3/-3 for 2 mana that consistently trades up.

name: Loot, the Anomaly
note: Threshold-gated sacrifice outlet is unreliable and the set doesn't support a sacrifice deck enough to make it good.

name: Mabel, Bitter Recluse
note: 1-mana 1/1 deathtouch that strips counters, especially good at killing Jace planeswalker tokens.

name: Massacre Girl, Most Wanted
note: A huge threat that punishes opponents whenever your creatures or planeswalkers die, dangerous if it survives removal.

name: Multiply by Zero
note: 2-mana instant-speed removal setting power/toughness to 0/0, blanked only by +1/+1 counters.

name: Proft, Sinister Mastermind
note: Even without threshold it doubles as a fine removal spell, and once enabled it's a cheap 5/5 menace.

name: Rampart Hunter
note: A clean, on-color effect but just not powerful enough to matter.

name: Rank Rat
note: 1-mana 1/1 that makes the opponent discard, a reliably solid Ravenous Rats variant.

name: Rewrite Regrets
note: Reanimation plus empower 2 is good value, especially with self-mill support fueling the graveyard.

name: Screeching Soulbreaker
note: A 3-mana 1/4 flyer that pings for 2 and gains a life on attack is solid value.

name: Silence the Echo
note: 5-mana sorcery-speed removal that drops to 2 mana if you sacrifice a creature or planeswalker.

name: Solve for Disappointment
note: Missing the discard turns a cheap edict-style effect into a disaster, best against decks with big permanents.

name: Terminal Criticism
note: Solid removal but color-restricted to blue or red, so it's mainly a sideboard card.

name: Teyo, Diamondblade Mage
note: Flash deathtouch/counter is fine but a 3/1 body for 4 mana underwhelms.

name: Theoretical Necromancer
note: Dies easily and the 4-mana Raise Dead ability is expensive, feels unpushed on both ends.

name: Tinybones, Pocket Nuisance
note: A better body than the 1-mana discard rat, trades with real creatures and pings repeatedly on future discards.

name: Void Extrapolator // Omit Variables
note: Efficient 2-mana 2/2 with Threshold upside, best as an enabler in blue-black self-mill.

name: Way of the Deathbringer
note: Replaces itself and can upgrade a bad creature into a 4/4, but only a good deal with expendable sacrifice fodder.

name: Way of the Necromancer
note: Only good if heavily invested in the empower/loyalty-counter theme, mediocre otherwise.

name: Winter, Tormented Loner
note: At worst an Edict effect; good if you have sacrifice fodder like small tokens, mediocre without it.

name: Yargle, Glutton of Urborg
note: The reprinted vanilla giant doesn't play well without evasion or protection.

name: Arni, Renowned Champion
note: 1/5 trample that grows on other creatures entering, swingy and a bit win-more but has upside.

name: Artifist Acumen
note: Only worth considering in a dedicated prowess deck; close to unplayable outside it.

name: Awaken the Inferno
note: 5-mana removal that also pumps your own creature and basic land cycles when not needed.

name: Blazing Crescendo
note: A replaceable combat trick that impulse-draws a card, but lacking trample hurts it against planeswalkers.

name: Chandra's Emberling
note: Marshall gives an optimistic C for the 2/2 haste counter-prowess common; Luis says probably a D, dislikes the haste and doubts the archetype's speed.

name: Command the Stage
note: Fun build-around for a prowess/token deck that returns itself, but a low-power 3-mana 2/2 at face value.

name: Eardrum Rattler
note: A cheap unblockable-enabler that's mediocre generally but notably good at pushing damage through to kill planeswalkers.

name: Essence Burn
note: Efficient exile removal for black or green threats, but too narrow to maindeck.

name: Fulminous Forte
note: 3-mana instant that can deal 5 damage to a creature or planeswalker, occasionally a board wipe mode.

name: Gallia, the Merrymaker
note: A haste lord that can also grant haste and a counter, but the activated ability costs too much mana to use often.

name: Hallway Heckler // Vicious Verse
note: A rummaging ability plus a cheap prepared burn spell gives it enough value for a bread-and-butter common.

name: Heartstring Puller
note: 3/1 trample for 4 that also makes a 2/2 token on entry, unusually strong for a common.

name: Jiang Yanggu, Alone
note: 5-mana 4/4 menace that loots and grows when attacking alone, good the turn it's cast.

name: Kiora of Fire and Ashes
note: 6 mana for a 2/2 plus a 5/5 flying dragon token, with a repeatable ability to make more dragons.

name: Koth, the Geomancer
note: 3/2 reach that pings opponents and can add mana off landfalled mountains, a scary threat to answer.

name: Marwyn, the Clearcutter
note: Efficient 1-mana 2/1 with a solid late-game card-draw sacrifice ability.

name: No Admittance
note: Efficient burn that also empowers Jace, an easy include.

name: Pia, Determined Rebuilder
note: 2/2 for 3 that makes a 1/1 flying Thopter, plus a scalable late-game pump ability off artifacts.

name: Skilled Battlecarver
note: The threat of its pump ability makes it an awkward attacker to block despite being a modest 2/1.

name: Tether Technician
note: 5-mana 4/5 reach that can discard a card to deal 2 damage to any target on entry.

name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Pursuer
note: 2/4 double strike and prowess that pings small blockers, hits hard and is tough to block profitably.

name: Tomik, Izzet Sparkmage
note: Boosts repeatable noncombat damage sources, especially good alongside the black-red 'deal 1' Prepare cards.

name: Violent Echoes
note: Instant-speed 6 damage that turns excess damage into planeswalker loyalty, effectively a clean 2-for-1.

name: Way of the Pyromancer
note: Empowers Jace 2 and gives planeswalkers a mana-ramping loyalty ability, strong early though weaker if drawn late.

name: Way of the Warlord
note: 3-mana instant-speed removal for a planeswalker that deals 2 to a creature and 2 to the player.

name: Winter, Team Player
note: Convoke lets you cast it cheaply and it pumps the team on noncreature spells, but wants a build-around deck.

name: Wrath of the Bloodmane
note: Instant-speed 4 damage to a creature or planeswalker, cost reduced to 2 mana with a legendary creature out.

name: Arcane Amphisbaena
note: 1-mana deathtouch snake that also empowers Jace, giving value or protection.

name: Bestial Incursion
note: 4-mana 4/4 trample with flashback 6; trample helps punch through token blockers.

name: Budding Insurgent
note: 3-mana 3/3 vigilance that can sac to destroy an artifact/enchantment, but feels off-brand in this synergy-heavy set.

name: Compel Brutality
note: Instant-speed bite or loyalty-damage removal that fits green well and lets Jace's loyalty deal damage too.

name: Edgar, Moonlit Sovereign
note: Flash 4/4 that can ambush an attacker and grow with counters, though not hugely better than a vanilla flash 4/4.

name: Fblthp, Knows the Way
note: Domain payoff that fetches basics to hand on ETB; overperforms even in two-color decks and helps splashes.

name: Flourishing Grapple
note: Confusingly worded but really just instant-speed bite with a narrow ability-strip upside against red or white.

name: Ghalta the Unstoppable
note: Cost reduced by your biggest creature's power; getting it out for 4-5 mana feels like a steal.

name: Greenhouse Propagator
note: Mana ramp creature that also gains life whenever another creature enters, nice even without synergies.

name: Heartwood Crafter // Soul Tether
note: Turns the Heartwood token into a turn-2 Rampant Growth-style ramp play, good even ignoring the mana ability.

name: Hunter's Axe
note: Cheap +2/+0 equipment granting trample or deathtouch on attack; decent but shares the usual equipment ceiling.

name: Inspired Tethermage
note: Grows via loyalty counters placed on planeswalkers, including its own Empower Jace activated ability.

name: Jiang Yanggu, Never Alone
note: 4 mana for a 2/2 plus a 3/3 token, essentially a cheap Grave Titan.

name: Loot, the Nexus
note: Fragile but powerful mana rock tapping for mana equal to the number of different creature powers you control.

name: Marwyn, the Preserver
note: Solid 2-mana 3/2 stats alone, plus land-recursion that shines with self-mill or discard synergies.

name: Pia, Aether Ascetic
note: Discard-to-tutor an enchantment off a 3-mana 2/2; only worth it with a strong enchantment payoff.

name: Restore with Empathy
note: Slow permanent-recursion plus 4 life; Marshall likes it for green-white lifegain, Luis rates it lower but fine in blue-green graveyard decks.

name: Ruric Thar, Magecrusher
note: Can't be countered and has hexproof until it deals combat damage, fixing the usual weakness of big ramp creatures.

name: Something Worth Saving
note: Mills 4, returns a permanent, and gains 1 life, enabling synergies across multiple archetypes despite low raw power.

name: Sureshot Sower
note: 2-mana 3/1 reach with a discard-to-kill-a-flyer ability; solid defensive stats for the cost.

name: Titanbones, Towering Heart
note: 4/3 reach that grows via lifegain triggers, plus a discard-for-3-life bonus.

name: Vinelasher Adept
note: 5/7 reach with basic landcycling for 2 mana, a great home for lands-needed counters.

name: Way of the Paradox
note: Draws off Jace and ramps a land; a build-around ranging from D if unsupported up to B with full planeswalker support.

name: Way of the Wildspeaker
note: Effectively a 5-mana 4/4 trample leaving behind a 3-loyalty Jace, a strong two-for-one.

name: Wrecking Gecko
note: Marshall settles on C- for the 5-mana 5/5 Ward 2 (up from the usual D+ for that slot); Luis likes the Ward 2 but gives no letter grade.

name: Yoshimaru, Scrappy Stray
note: 2-mana fight spell that leaves behind a 1/1 body, plus a clunky late-game counter ability.

name: Desperate Futurescribe
note: 4-mana 3/4 flyer that upgrades pumps into counters whenever you scry or surveil.

name: Fatehold Charm
note: Flexible modal instant, good with creatures out or with an empty board.

name: Fatehold Chronologist // Peer Review
note: Smooth 2-into-3 curve, a flyer plus a 2/2 and a Surveil; also useful to kill early.

name: Prudent Fateseer // Peer Review
note: Repeatable team pump off scry/surveil, but an unexciting 1/4 body with no evasion.

name: Paradox Shaper // Omit Variables
note: Self-mill and library-filtering engine that can loop card advantage; better if the deck needs threshold.

name: Recursive Recruitment
note: 4 mana for two 2/2s that can flash back later for much bigger, counter-boosted tokens.

name: Theorix Charm
note: Modal instant compared to Spell Pierce plus Disfigure plus a mill-3-draw-1 mode.

name: Theorix Metamage // Omit Variables
note: Hybrid enabler/payoff for threshold with good stats late in the game.

name: Grim Repriser
note: 2-mana 2/2 with prowess that can return from the graveyard once an opponent takes noncombat damage.

name: Stingerquill Charm
note: Near-Lightning-Bolt mode plus a hasty 2/2 token option make it very flexible.

name: Stingerquill Voxmancer // Vicious Verse
note: Cheap repeatable pinger that enables the damage-matters theme, worse if the archetype underperforms.

name: Whiplash Wordsmith // Vicious Verse
note: 4-mana 3/3 that gains flying and haste when the opponent has taken noncombat damage.

name: Craftwork Crusher
note: 7-mana 7/5 trample with a strong choose-2 ETB, but expensive and hard to splash.

name: Konstrari Charm
note: Weak modal charm; the counters-plus-trample combat trick mode is the only strong option.

name: Konstrari Improviser // Soul Tether
note: Expensive ramp payoff putting mediocre stuff into play; skeptical it's worth the mana investment.

name: Woodwork Prodigy // Soul Tether
note: 3-mana 3/3 that trades well and piles up mana toward bigger payoffs.

name: Bloombrute
note: 4/4 for 4 that draws a card whenever you gain life, extremely well supported by the archetype.

name: Emergency Phytomedic // Seed Suture
note: Flexible 1-drop that grows into a decent body and enables the archetype's lifegain payoffs.

name: Vigorbloom Charm
note: Versatile charm offering protection, card draw plus lifegain, or a pump-and-fight mode.

name: Vigorbloom Vanguard // Seed Suture
note: 2-mana 2/2 that grants vigilance to countered creatures and can pump plus gain life.

name: Blessed Ghoul
note: Cheap lifelinker whose 3-mana recursion is steep, but incremental lifelink value adds up over a game.

name: Edgar, Ancient Bloodlord
note: Hard-to-block 2/3 that gains life on creature deaths and grows via sacrifice, benefits from synergy support.

name: Twisted Fates
note: 5-mana removal that also pumps a player's whole board, like a 3/3 haste attached to a kill spell.

name: Clash of Elements
note: Cheap, flexible instant that either bounces a permanent or deals damage, no restrictive clauses.

name: Saheeli, Jewel of Avishkar
note: Makes hasty thopter tokens off any noncreature spell, a strong mild build-around for the archetype.

name: Twinned Vision
note: Flashback card draw hurt badly by the mandatory discard cost on the flashback side.

name: Ferocity of the Hunt
note: Cheap deathtouch aura that returns its creature on death, pairs well with trample synergies.

name: Hapatra, the Desert Fang
note: 5-mana 3/3 that shrinks a creature based on the highest mana value in the graveyard, reliably strong.

name: Primal Witchstalker
note: 2/1 menace that mills 4 and returns a land to the battlefield, a strong 3-drop.

name: Charge the Sanctum
note: Expensive but powerful combat trick that can pump the team or give first strike plus a counter.

name: Mabel, Valley Hero
note: Comes down as a 2/3 that gives every entering creature an extra counter, seen as a must-kill threat.

name: Warrior's Blades
note: Equipment that enters like a Lightning Helix, then leaves behind solid +2/+1 equipment.

name: Kiora of Salt and Sand
note: Build-around that turns empowered Jace loyalty into an unblockable attack and an 8/8 hexproof ultimate, but needs setup.

name: Mind Meanderer
note: 6-mana 4/4 flier that fights on ETB is a solid two-for-one, though slow and only kills small creatures.

name: Tam's Resistance
note: 2 mana for counter, vigilance, and a card back fits great in prowess decks that want cheap cantrips.

name: Afterthought Sentry
note: Clunky 2/2 with an expensive flying activation, though exiling graveyard cards on attack has minor upside.

name: Archive Arbiter
note: 6-mana 4/4 flyer that either gains 4 life or destroys a noncreature nonland permanent, a solid top-end 2-for-1.

name: Eye of Jace
note: 1-mana artifact that surveils each turn and eventually sacrifices for damage and life; best in surveil/graveyard decks.

name: Keeper of the Quiet Hour
note: 3/2 for 3 that empowers a planeswalker by 2 on entry, solid for a colorless common.

name: Living Library
note: The sacrifice-bounce ability needs too many specific pieces to line up; effectively unplayable.

name: Medic's Kitesail
note: Cheap equipment giving +1/+0, flying, and lifegain on attack; a fringe playable that can quietly pull weight.

name: Murmuring Volume
note: Mana rock that can also loot, but unclear which archetype actually wants a colorless ramp-and-filter artifact.

name: Traxos, Scourge Eternal
note: 4-mana 5/4 trample that untaps whenever you cast an artifact or creature spell, trivially easy to keep active.

name: Fatehold Annex
note: Enters tapped unless you control a planeswalker, a cycle land that's about average value like most fixing lands.

name: Theorix Annex
note: Graded as a cycle - all five annexes are the same card. Marshall: don't overlook these if you're heavy on playables.

name: Stingerquill Annex
note: Graded as a cycle - all five annexes are the same card. Marshall: don't overlook these if you're heavy on playables.

name: Konstrari Annex
note: Graded as a cycle - all five annexes are the same card. Marshall: don't overlook these if you're heavy on playables.

name: Vigorbloom Annex
note: Graded as a cycle - all five annexes are the same card. Marshall: don't overlook these if you're heavy on playables.

name: Hexhaven Dueling Arena
note: Colorless land whose activated ability to make a creature prepared isn't worth the mana-fixing cost.

name: Room of Refuge
note: Enters tapped for any color with no shuffling, plus a late-game sac ability to add +1/+1 counters.
